verdict.rationale: Square has documented sandbox tooling with dedicated pages for sandbox payments and sandbox testing for disputes, plus idempotency support for safe test retries. However, evidence doesn't show a comprehensive test-card matrix covering every decline/dispute scenario, nor confirmation that sandbox fully mirrors production behavior end-to-end. Missing for 10: explicit list of test card numbers for various decline codes, documented parity guarantees between sandbox and production, and independent developer confirmation of sandbox fidelity.
